user.title: User
user.description: Registered patient or doctor account with bcrypt-hashed password

name.description: Display name of the patient or doctor

assignedDoctorId.description: Optional assigned doctor user ID for patient accounts

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when account was created

reading.title: Glucose Reading
reading.description: Single blood glucose measurement in mg/dl for a patient, date, and time slot

date.description: Local calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format

value.description: Blood glucose value in mg/dl (whole number between 40 and 600)

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when reading was created

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when reading was last updated

/users/{userId}.description: Collection of patient and doctor user accounts

/readings/{readingId}.description: Collection of blood glucose readings indexed by patient userId, date, and slot
